A '''nameless green puddinglike mass''' was an edible substance. [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Sarkin]] received a serving of this substance for [[breakfast]] on one occasion at [[Folor Base]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. When [[Kell Tainer]] joined her, he observed her stirring the mass on her plate rather than consuming it.
